messages:
maria_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp POC: they want SOC2 + ISO artifacts, a signed pen-test letter, and a short window to test an on-prem connector. Also asked for a rough dedicated pricing quote (they expect ~100k tokens/mo) and staging creds for their network team. Can we align owners?

aj_deploy: +1 — I can provision an ephemeral staging env, but need network details: IP ranges, inbound rules, and whether they require a VPN or SSH bastion.

kevin_security: For the pen-test letter we need the scope: which hosts/IPs, whether tester is internal/3rd-party, and expected test window. Also confirm if Acme needs signed attestation or just statement of readiness.

lisa_legal: They'll also require DPA + signed addendum for the connector. We need a copy of their security questionnaire answered before we send anything signed. Can maria share the questionnaire link?

maria_sales: Link: https://acme.example.com/sec-questionnaire (they filled first pass). Key asks: data residency (EU), on-prem connector (reads customer S3 over TLS), pen-test acceptance, dedicated capacity SLA.

mike_eng: For dedicated pricing: if it's just 100k tokens/mo and modest concurrency, we can do a small Dedicated pool. Rough ballpark: $Xk/mo for reserved + per-token delta. Need to know model size (7B vs 34B) — quantization matters for pricing. Also, on-prem connector: do they want data plane in their VPC or just a connector that ships to Redwood Private?

maria_sales: They explicitly asked for an agent inside their VPC that forwards requests to Redwood Private control plane.

aj_deploy: Ok — for VPC peering we need network CIDRs and a ticket to cloud infra to set up peering. For initial testing I can spin up a temporary bastion + a one-off env that exposes a test endpoint (TLS) and gives them a client cert.

kevin_security: Two security items: 1) pen-test letter template — we have a standard. 2) For SOC2/ISO artifacts we can provide the attestation PDFs and a short controls summary, but any production-level on-prem deployment will need a security review. I can share artifact list.

maria_sales: Thanks — can you drop the artifact list here? Acme needs to know what they'll get and what's redacted.

kevin_security: Artifact list (summary): SOC2 Type II attestation (pdf), ISO 27001 certificate summary (scope page), penetration test acceptance letter template, summary of encryption and key management controls, and access to our compliance repository for redacted evidence. For anything with sensitive IP (detailed config), we give redacted screens and a statement of control.

lisa_legal: Also note: before we share pen-test letter signed by legal, we need their legal contact and PoC to confirm scoping language. Suggest we send the template, ask them to confirm scope, then we'll sign.

maria_sales: Customer point: kate@acme.com (security@acme is cc). They want the signed letter within 5 business days. Meeting requested tomorrow EOD.

aj_deploy: I provisioned an ephemeral staging env: ID env-stg-2109, endpoint https://stg-2109.redwood.internal (temp cert). deploy-bot: provision results below.

deploy-bot: env-stg-2109 created by aj_deploy — 1 small GPU node, client cert fingerprint: 3f:2a:... TTL 72h.

aj_deploy: To create a temp client token for their network team, run: 

```
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/temporary-keys 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"env":"env-stg-2109","ttl":86400}'
```

mike_eng: For dedicated pricing estimate I can give two options: Dedicated-small (1xA10-like, ~SLA 99.5) or Dedicated-medium (2xA100-like, better p99). Which performance tier does Acme need?

maria_sales: They emphasized latency for inference (p99 < 300ms) during POC. Probably Dedicated-medium. Also they want cost predictability for procurement.

kevin_security: Regarding the pen-test letter: I'll attach the template after this thread. We typically require 48-72h to review third-party scope before signing. If they need a signature within 5 business days, we can probably do it if scope is clear and limited to the ephemeral staging env.

lisa_legal: Procurement will still want to see our standard terms. I'll prepare a short DPA addendum and request their legal contact for redlines.

maria_sales: Next steps I propose: 1) I send pen-test scope to kevin + lisa (today). 2) aj to confirm network delta for peering + the temp token. 3) mike to finalize Dedicated-medium quote and runbook for the POC. 4) Set a 30-min sync with Acme tomorrow 4pm PST. Anyone object?

kevin_security: +1. I'm on it.

mike_eng: +1 — I'll post the quote in this thread later today.

aj_deploy: +1 — token created on demand, will DM the cert fingerprint to their engineer.

lisa_legal: +1 — will start DPA draft.

maria_sales: Great — I'll schedule the call and share calendar invite. Thanks all :thumbsup:
